title: Anatomy Contextualized Adaptation of CT Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.27154v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: CT vision-language foundation models have demonstrated promising performance across downstream tasks, but are typically trained with whole-volume representations that dilute fine-grained anatomical signals. Fine-grained vision-language pre-training addresses this by aligning anatomy-level visual features with anatomy-specific text, but in doing so discards the global context that whole-volume models provide. Furthermore, existing fine-grained approaches train from scratch, making them computationally expensive. We introduce Anatomy Contextualized Adaptation (ACA), a lightweight framework that adapts frozen CT foundation model representations for anatomy-level vision-language alignment while enhancing global contextualization. ACA uses TotalSegmentator to decompose CT volumes into anatomy-level embeddings, which are refined via a transformer that captures cross-anatomy relationships, and aligned to both per-anatomy and scan-leve

translated_title: 解剖情境化适配的CT基础模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.27154v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：CT视觉语言基础模型在下游任务中表现出色，但通常使用整体体积表示进行训练，这稀释了细粒度的解剖信号。细粒度视觉语言预训练通过将解剖级视觉特征与解剖特定文本对齐来解决这一问题，但这样做却丢弃了整体体积模型提供的全局上下文。此外，现有的细粒度方法从头开始训练，计算成本高昂。我们引入了解剖情境化适配（ACA），这是一种轻量级框架，用于适配冻结的CT基础模型表示，以实现解剖级视觉语言对齐，同时增强全局情境化。ACA使用TotalSegmentator将CT体积分解为解剖级嵌入，通过一个捕捉跨解剖关系的变换器进行细化，并对齐到每个解剖和扫描级别。
tldr: 本文提出ACA框架，通过轻量级适配冻结的CT基础模型，实现解剖级视觉语言对齐并保留全局上下文，避免从头训练的计算开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ACA, a lightweight framework that adapts frozen CT foundation models for anatomy-level vision-language alignment while preserving global context, avoiding the computational cost of training from scratch.
